jobs.description: Become a Part of Accurids Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. You will own our compliance programme, act as our Information Security Officer and become the central contact for security, privacy and contract obligations. You track the security, privacy and compliance obligations in our customer contracts and make sure we stay compliant. You plan and lead internal and external audits and answer customer security questionnaires. You run risk assessments, maintain policies and lead the response to security incidents. You raise security awareness across the team through trainings and clear guidelines. What helps you succeed: At least 3 years of experience in information security, ideally in a SaaS or software company. Hands-on experience running an ISO 27001 ISMS, including certification or surveillance audits. You work independently, set priorities on your own and enjoy taking ownership and improving how things work. You explain requirements in a way that engineers, management and customers understand. You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit. Business-fluent English and German.
